description: Internal links to add, from the latest finished site audit: a target page that has a Search Console query at positions 4–20, and a source page of the same site whose text contains that query and does not link to the target yet. Each row has sourceUrl, targetUrl, query, snippet (up to 160 characters of the source text where the link fits), impressions (of the query on the target page, last 28 days) and position (average, lower is better). Ordered by impressions of the target; up to 3 sources per target and query. Page text is not stored, only the snippet. Use it to improve internal linking for pages already close to page one. / Links internos a criar: página de origem, destino, consulta, trecho, impressões e posição.

site.description: Property: displayName ("example.com"), Search Console siteUrl ("sc-domain:example.com", "https://www.example.com/") or numeric id. A unique substring among visible properties also works ("exam"). list_sites shows the options. The value "demo" selects a demonstration site with fictional data: it works without signing in and is read-only. / Propriedade por nome, siteUrl ou id; "demo" é um site de demonstração com dados fictícios, sem login e só leitura.

targetContains.description: Only targets whose URL contains this text (case-insensitive), e.g. "/blog/".
